reading_extent.submission: All six physical and printed author pages, including the complete opening timetable paragraph and conclusion.
reading_extent.addressed_draft: July 20 regulation proposal: cover, operative pages 2–3, explanatory page 8; not the whole draft.
reading_extent.primary_law: Official current IDNrG § 2 no. 1, RegMoG Article 22, and both pages of the original 2023 I no. 230 commencement notice.

assessment: The cited August 31, 2028 deadline is a narrow factual timetable error. The statute requires the end of the fifth calendar year following commencement, not five calendar anniversaries. The official notice brings § 2 into force on August 31, 2023, yielding December 31, 2028. The exact addressed draft expressly uses that December date.

benign_alternatives_tested.alternative: Five years after commencement on August 31, 2023.
benign_alternatives_tested.result: This explains a possible anniversary calculation but conflicts with the express calendar-year rule; no intent is inferred.

benign_alternatives_tested.alternative: A separate NOOTS operational or political target.
benign_alternatives_tested.result: The author expressly describes the deadline fixed for the other registers and later invokes the deadlines provided by IDNrG. The full statement provides no separately identified NOOTS deadline. Targeted exact-date searches did not supply an affirmative rescue, but the finding rests on the statute and exact draft rather than search absence.

materiality: Four months are added to the apparent mismatch with the ground-register end-2032 deadline. This slightly strengthens the explicit request to examine shortening that deadline, but an approximately four-year gap remains after correction. It does not undermine the broader synchronisation or cadastral integration rationale.
limits: No claim that acceleration is undesirable, that all registers are otherwise ready, or that the author acted intentionally. Source dates are not evidence of actual delivery.

sources.access: Original two-page PDF downloaded and all text read; web reader inaccessible.

source_quote_policy: No submission quotations repeated in this review.
